sections.title: Overview
descriptions: This page brings together available employment and compensation records related to Beverly R. Davis.
Beverly R. Davis is listed as a records supervisor in the latest available Transparent Utah records for fiscal year 2026.

sections.title: Employment
descriptions: Transparent Utah records show Beverly R. Davis working for American Fork as a records supervisor since at least fiscal year 2014, with records through 2026. The compensation data used here begins in 2014, so the actual start year may have been earlier.
The records list Police Secretary in 2014–2015 and Records Supervisor from 2016 onward.
These years are based on reported pay, not exact hire or departure dates. Records through 2026 suggest continued employment, but do not confirm current status.
